html:
The Coconut War was a short revolt on Espiritu Santo in 1980, when the Nagriamel movement of Jimmy Stevens declared the island independent as Vemerana on the eve of Vanuatu's independence.

Stevens was backed by French settlers and by an American group seeking a tax haven. British and French troops sent in did little. After independence on 30 July, Prime Minister Walter Lini called in soldiers from Papua New Guinea, who ended the revolt within weeks with little fighting.

Stevens was jailed. The revolt drew on real grievances over land on Santo and the split left by the condominium. Its name comes from the copra plantations of the island; see copra.
sum: The Coconut War was a short revolt on Espiritu Santo in 1980, when the Nagriamel movement of Jimmy Stevens declared the island independent as Vemerana on the eve of Vanuatu's independence.
